setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (an admin user). Note whether the account has an active Cloudflare Turnstile service credential: several expectations depend on it. <form> is an existing test form that creates a Contact, stores its submissions and has at least one failed submission (for example a repeated email).

evals.prompt: Create a contact form on <domain> that asks for name, email, phone and a message, and creates a contact for each submission. Anyone on the internet should be able to send it.
evals.expected_output: Reads the Contact fields, writes the form in the builder's format, previews, asks for a yes, creates it with an explicit public mode and captcha, and gives the view link.
expectations: Uses scripts/form.js (fields, preview, create), never a hand-made POST to /v2/form
fieldMap keys are the form field keys and its values are Contact field paths from 'fields' (email → email); the email question is required and uses {"type":"String","format":"email"}
Sets access.mode to "public" explicitly, with captcha on, and waits for an explicit yes before create
If preview says the account has no Cloudflare credential, tells the user nobody can send the form until an admin adds one (or captcha is turned off with their consent)
Reports the https://<domain>/v2/form/view/<_id> link and who can send it

evals.prompt: Necesito un formulario de soporte en <domain> que cree un ticket con el asunto y la descripción del problema, y que solo lo puedan llenar usuarios con sesión iniciada.
evals.expected_output: Answers in Spanish; maps both required Ticket fields from required questions; access.mode authenticated; preview, yes, create.
expectations: Runs 'fields <domain> Ticket' and maps subject and description, the Ticket's required fields, from required questions
Sets access.mode to "authenticated" and explains that only signed-in users of the account can send it
Does not create anything before the user's explicit yes to the preview

evals.prompt: Our form <form> says the message was sent, but no new contact shows up. Why?
evals.expected_output: Reads the form with show, reads the stored submissions, finds the failed mapping result and explains it in plain words, without writing anything.
expectations: Explains that the submission answers 200 even when a mapping fails, and names the actual error from the stored result (for example Duplicated value: the email already exists and that contact got a note)
Does not send a test submission or change the form without asking

evals.prompt: The form <form> asks for a captcha but there is no captcha on the page, so nobody can send it. Fix it.
evals.setup: <form> has an empty access.mode and captcha on.
evals.expected_output: Finds the empty access mode, proposes an explicit mode, previews the change with --form, asks for a yes, updates with the form version and reads back.
expectations: Identifies the cause: access.mode is empty, so the server asks for a captcha the page never shows (or, for public mode, the missing Cloudflare credential)
Asks the user which mode they want instead of turning captcha off on its own
Uses preview --form and then update with --form-version and --confirmed; the read-back shows the new mode

evals.prompt: On <form>, remove the phone question and add a required 'Company' question. Keep everything else.
evals.expected_output: Sends the full new formSchema and mappings without the phone key; the company answer is left unmapped (Contact has no free-text company field) or mapped only to a field 'fields' lists.
expectations: Sends the whole formSchema (every remaining field plus the new one), not only the new field
Also sends mappings without the phone key, so the save is not rejected
Does not map the company answer to a path that 'fields' does not list; explains where an unmapped answer is kept
Previews, waits for a yes, updates with --form-version, and reports saved true
